verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm offering legal services plus client-facing extranets and internal legal AI tools. It is not an AI agent or client application, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
